references.context: An underlying subset A for which at least one element exists; source convention excludes the empty set.
Intersection of A with each open U from the ambient topology tau.
The collection of all sets A cap U for U in tau, defining the open sets on A.

references.phrase: exclusion of empty A by convention
references.disposition: This is a restricted convention, not an assertion that the general subspace topology cannot be defined on the empty set.

review_rationale: Reviewed restricted topology convention under which only nonempty subsets may be topological subspaces; kept identical induced-open-set construction but not the unrestricted empty case.
